en.NoneHint: Create an identity to give a folder its own Git name, email and SSH key.
en.Name: Name
en.ScopeHint: Used when no folder rule matches.
en.NeedAlias: Enter an alias to add the platform default rewrite.
en.RegenFailed: Saved, but the generated configuration could not be rewritten: %s.
en.KeyNotDeleted: The identity is deleted, but its private key is not: %s.
en.ReadOnlyHint: Idset will not write to it until it is fixed or restored from a backup.
en.DelBody: The identity is removed from the list and the generated configuration. These are not deleted automatically:
en.DelNote: Project folders on disk are never touched.
en.KeyNote: Only the private key is deleted; the .pub file stays.
en.ReasonNoKey: This identity has no key path.
en.ReasonShared: Another identity (%s) uses the same key.
en.ReasonSymlink: The key path is a symbolic link; Idset will not delete it.
en.ReasonMissing: The key file does not exist.
en.ReasonNotFile: The key path is not a regular file.
en.ErrAlias: Use letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens only.
en.ErrDuplicateAlias: Another identity (%s) already uses this alias.
en.ErrReservedAlias: This is the real host name of a platform; choose another alias.
en.ErrBadHost: The host name has characters it cannot have.
en.ErrBadPort: Use port 22 or 443 for this platform, or 1 to 65535 for a custom one.
en.ErrQuote: Double quotes are not allowed here.
en.ErrSecondGlobal: There is already a global identity. Change %s to limited first.
en.ErrBadColor: Use one of the six colors or a hex value such as #3A7BD5.

zh-Hans.NoneHint: 新建一个身份，让文件夹用上自己的 Git 署名、邮箱和 SSH 密钥。
zh-Hans.Name: 名称
zh-Hans.ScopeHint: 没有 gitdir 规则命中时生效。
zh-Hans.NeedAlias: 先填别名，才能添加平台默认改写。
zh-Hans.RegenFailed: 已保存，但生成的配置没能重新写入：%s。
zh-Hans.KeyNotDeleted: 身份已删除，但私钥没有删除：%s。
zh-Hans.ReadOnlyHint: 修好文件或从备份恢复之前，Idset 不会写入它。
zh-Hans.DelBody: 身份会从列表和生成的配置里移除。下面这些不会自动删除：
zh-Hans.DelNote: 磁盘上的项目文件夹不会被改动。
zh-Hans.KeyNote: 只删私钥，保留 .pub 文件。
zh-Hans.ReasonNoKey: 这个身份没有私钥路径。
zh-Hans.ReasonShared: 其他身份（%s）也在用这个私钥。
zh-Hans.ReasonSymlink: 私钥路径是符号链接，Idset 不会删除。
zh-Hans.ReasonNotFile: 私钥路径不是普通文件。
zh-Hans.ErrAlias: 只能用字母、数字、点、下划线和连字符。
zh-Hans.ErrDuplicateAlias: 其他身份（%s）已经在用这个别名。
zh-Hans.ErrReservedAlias: 这是某个平台的真实主机名，请换一个别名。
zh-Hans.ErrBadHost: 主机名里有不能用的字符。
zh-Hans.ErrBadPort: 这个平台的端口只能是 22 或 443；自定义平台可以用 1 到 65535。
zh-Hans.ErrSecondGlobal: 已有全局身份。先把 %s 改成限定。
zh-Hans.ErrBadColor: 请用六个预设色之一，或 #3A7BD5 这样的十六进制值。
